noticed a bit of a discharge from my left ear yesterday and it got worse overnight. Rather than bother the GP surgery with this I decided to ask a pharmacy for advice as I was near one in Ransom’s this morning. They advised that since my ear was discharging I should really see my GP.
Around 12md I called the surgery and explained the situation. The receptionist asked if I could come in this afternoon and I said I could. At 12:30 I got another call from the surgery offering me an appointment at 15:25 which I gratefully accepted. I was seen by Dr Martin slightly ahead of this, had my ears examined and drops prescribed.
I was headed home 10 minutes later with my drops in hand.
I wanted to thank the staff at the practice for a fabulous experience and the least I could do was share it with others.
